title: Interdomain Attention: Beyond Token-Level Key-Value Memory
abstract: arXiv:2605.24330v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Softmax attention-based transformers and recurrent memory-based models (e.g., state space models (SSMs)) form the foundation of modern sequence models. Hybrid architectures aim to combine the expressivity from attention and the computational efficiency from recurrent memory, yet so far common practices simply stack both attention and recurrent layers. We propose Interdomain Attention (IA) as a novel hybrid attention architecture that mixes attention and recurrent memory in the same layer. Motivated by a kernel regression view of softmax attention, IA compresses values and kernel features of keys into a recurrent memory parameterized by an SSM. Then IA approximates dot-product attention by implicitly reconstructing the attention matrix and values from memory states; importantly this construction maintains SSM's computational efficiency advantage. translated_title: 跨域注意力：超越词元级键值记忆
translated_abstract: 基于Softmax注意力的Transformer和基于循环记忆的模型（如状态空间模型（SSM））构成了现代序列模型的基础。混合架构旨在结合注意力的表达能力与循环记忆的计算效率，然而到目前为止，常见的做法只是简单地将注意力层和循环层堆叠在一起。我们提出了跨域注意力（Interdomain Attention, IA），这是一种新颖的混合注意力架构，它在同一层中融合注意力和循环记忆。受softmax注意力核回归视角的启发，IA将值以及键的核特征压缩到由SSM参数化的循环记忆中。然后，IA通过从记忆状态中隐式重建注意力矩阵和值来近似点积注意力；重要的是，这种构建方式保持了SSM的计算效率优势。我们通过设计和预训练IA网络架构来展示IA的有效性……
tldr: 提出跨域注意力（IA）这一新型混合架构，在同一层内将键值信息压缩到SSM参数化的循环记忆中并隐式重建注意力矩阵，从而在保持SSM计算效率的同时近似点积注意力。
